pull.title: guix: followups to #35537
pull.body: This deduplicates setup code, as well as adds flags to turn linker warnings into errors, which is easier now that the GUI build has been split out (the gui link warns about shared libs during linking).

events.body: The following sections might be updated with supplementary metadata relevant to reviewers and maintainers. ### Code Coverage & Benchmarks For details see: https://corecheck.dev/bitcoin/bitcoin/pulls/35821. ### Reviews See [the guideline](https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#code-review) and [AI policy](https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/blob/master/doc/AI_POLICY.md) for information on the review process. | Type | Reviewers | | ---- | --------- | | ACK | [hebasto](https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/35821#pullrequestreview-4806950857) | If your review is incorrectly listed, please copy-paste <!--meta-tag:bot-skip--> into the comment that the bot should ignore. ### Conflicts Reviewers, this pull request conflicts with the following ones: * [#25573](https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/25573) (guix: produce a `-static-pie` bitcoind by fanquake) If you consider this pull request important, please also help to review the conflicting pull requests. Ideally, start with the one that should be merged first.

3f70305cf8226f9b2b82cf00d2c9d4592f218768 "guix: turn linux/win linker warnings into errors"

Why not in `contrib/guix/libexec/build_linux_gui.sh` as well?

"warning: libgcc_s.so.1, needed by /bitcoin/depends/\<host\>/lib/libfontconfig.so, not found (try using -rpath or -rpath-link)" can be silenced by `-Wl,-rpath-link=$(store_path "gcc-cross-${HOST}" lib)/${HOST}/lib`.

> Why not in contrib/guix/libexec/build_linux_gui.sh as well?
> can be silenced by -Wl,-rpath-link=$(store_path "gcc-cross-${HOST}" lib)/${HOST}/lib.

I didn't really want to make changes to the GUI build/deps here, and I think it would be better to build the libs with `-static-libgcc`, rather than passing flags to silence (legitimate) output?
